items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

items.name: squircle
items.title: Squircle
items.description: The Calamansi surface: a figma-squircle superellipse painted on its own layer, with the font family's drop-shadow lift.

items.name: liquid
items.title: Liquid Bar
items.description: The Calamansi fuse: squircle surfaces painted on their own layers, a seam between them crossed by a real metaball thread that severs at 1.234 of the blur and leaves a bead of liquid behind — for anything whose pieces have to pull apart and snap back together.

items.name: calamansi
items.title: Calamansi
items.description: A tiny citrus fruit that blinks, tracks the cursor, blushes when petted and goes tart when poked too much.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: The plain Calamansi surface as a card: one flat layer clipped to the squircle, in the Calamansi, White, Slate and Citrus palettes.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card on the Calamansi squircle surface, featuring 3D spring tilt physics and an interactive light sheen.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite marquee that pauses on hover and fades its edges.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: An odometer-style number that rolls to each new value, on the Calamansi squircle surface.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A dock that magnifies the item under the pointer, Mac-style, sitting on the Calamansi squircle panel.

items.name: gooey-nav
items.title: Gooey Nav
items.description: A Calamansi squircle nav whose active pill is fused to the tray by a real metaball filter, parts mid-flight and leaves a bead of palette juice behind.

items.name: duration-picker
items.title: Duration Picker
items.description: A Calamansi duration field: hours, minutes and a save button fused into one bar by a real metaball thread, splitting apart to be edited, merging back on commit and leaving a bead of palette juice where the thread parts.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A Calamansi squircle island that eases between a compact bar and a slab as it morphs states — the corner the kit's 28px capped by the brand's share of the box, the content clipped to that same curve — and glows when it alerts.

items.name: task-widget
items.title: Task Widget
items.description: An iOS-inspired glassmorphism widget with a live digital clock, dynamic weather status, fine grain noise and tactile task cards — on its own radius, or the Calamansi squircle corner.

items.name: morning-widget
items.title: Morning Widget
items.description: A Calamansi squircle card holding a drifting sunrise mesh that greets you by name, keeps a live clock with rolling digits, leans towards the pointer and cycles motivational lines with a staged reveal.

items.name: github-activity
items.title: GitHub Activity
items.description: A Calamansi squircle calendar plotting a year of GitHub contributions, with a drawer stacking the busiest repositories over it.

items.name: matrix-orb
items.title: Matrix Orb
items.description: A liquid orb on the same metaball fuse the Gooey nav runs: one core and a ring of satellites joined by necks into a single body — breathing while idle, rippling while listening until the lobes come off as droplets, and churning while it thinks.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A docs sidebar of sections whose single active marker arcs between rows and crossfades out of one section's ink into the next, drawn either as a static rail or as the same panel in a drawer.
